title: Guard feed fetches so one bad source cannot interrupt the site
rootCause: Feed refresh work can be degraded by slow or failing external RSS sources. The root cause is unisolated source failure risk: each source needs its own timeout, catch path, and diagnostic record so one bad feed cannot interrupt the overall news payload.
proposedFix: Wrap every feed fetch in a bounded timeout and try/catch, return an empty story list for the failed source, record source-level telemetry, and keep the rest of the feeds/cache path running.
ownerNote: Owner approved correcting Framework-identified issue; reconciled after feed guard implementation was confirmed in server.js.
verificationPlan: Call /api/feed-status and confirm JSON response includes source errors instead of endpoint failure.
Run /api/health?refresh=1 and confirm public health responds.
Confirm framework proof log records proposal and verification.
rollbackPlan: Revert only the feed fetch guard changes in server.js if feed loading or diagnostics regress.
nextStep: Completed. Feed fetch timeout, source error telemetry, and feed-status diagnostics are present. Run node --check server.js and /api/feed-status during deployment verification.
